text:
ana: Quick heads-up — we just GA'ed the new LowCost-Quant model family on Hosted API (lowcost-quant-v1). :tada:
ana: Key points: low latency for short-to-medium context, ~3-4x token cost reduction vs standard float32 models (workload dependent), supports streaming and tool-calling, and has automated kv-prefix caching enabled by default. Docs: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/hosted/lowcost-quant-v1
ana: New endpoint: POST /v1/generate?model=lowcost-quant-v1 — same API surface, no client-side changes required beyond the model param. We also added a new header `X-Quant-Profile` to opt into extra compression (optional).
ana: Rollout: live in us-west1 & eu-west1. Remaining regions next 48h. No customer-facing downtime expected. :white_check_mark:
mike: Runtime note — kernel selection and quant kernels were flipped at 1935002520 in the deploy. If you see TPU fallback logs, it means kernel negotiation fell back; that's expected for a small set of older instances. We're throttling bursts to preserve host SLOs.
mike: Suggested tuning: set `batch_size: auto` or `max_batch_tokens: 2048` for predictable latency in bursty workloads. Example config in case someone needs it:
```
serving.profile = "low_latency"
model.params = {"max_batch_tokens": 2048, "kv_cache": "auto"}
```
devx: Will update SDK changelog and add the new model id to the dropdowns. Any change to streaming frames or chunking semantics?
ana: Streaming semantics unchanged — same newline-delimited SSE chunks. Only difference: chunk sizes may be smaller due to quantized token generation cadence. No protocol changes.
sre-ops: What about SLOs and alerting? We should have dashboards + alerts for error rate spike and increased decode latency.
mike: Dashboards created — link: https://internal.redwood.ai/dashboards/lowcost-quant (internal). Alerts: `decode_latency_p95 > 800ms` or `error_rate > 0.5%` trigger an SRE pager.
sre-ops: Thanks. Please add a synthetic test hitting the tool-calling path — last canary missed a function-call edge-case.
jamal: Reported one issue during canary: when a request uses function-calling with an empty `arguments` object, runtime returned `tool_call: missing schema` instead of forwarding to tool router. Repro snippet:
```json
{"input": "get-user", "tool_call": {"name": "lookup", "arguments": {}}}
```
jamal: Filed ticket RED-9082.
ana: Assigned to eng-runtime to triage. We're prioritizing a patch; ETA EOD.
deploy-bot: deployment/redwood/runtime/lowcost-quant v1.0.3 succeeded (job 87921) :rocket:
eva: Coordinating customer comms: propose in-app banner + email to customers on self-serve with >100k tokens/month, and draft note to enterprise CSMs with migration guidance.
ana: Good plan — please proceed. I'll own the support KB and migration guide. Migration tips: replace `model` param, set `X-Quant-Profile` if you want extra compression, and prefer `max_tokens` caps for safety.
devx: One more ask — can we add a short sample to the quickstart that shows tool-calling with lowcost-quant? I'll open a PR.
mike: Ack. We'll watch RED-9082 and roll patch ASAP. If any customer hits regressions, automatic fallback to `standard-v1` is enabled for GA customers (no API change required).
ana: Final note: deprecating `quant-slim-v0` in 90 days — we'll send migration emails and auto-fallback will route legacy requests to `standard-v1` if unpatched. :memo:
ana: Thanks everyone — big effort from runtime, infra, and devx teams. Shoutouts to jamal and mike for the last-minute fixes. :clap:
